Senses.Explanation: (參) = to investigate, consult, look into (as one 參 a teacher or 參究 a matter); (禪) = Chan. (參禪) is the recorded activity of investigating Chan, which the corpus binds to the one great matter of life and death. Gaofeng Yuanmiao states its temper: (參禪須是鐵漢) — to investigate Chan one must be an iron man — (著手心頭便判) (the moment you set to it the mind is decided). He binds it to the one great matter: (只遮生死一大事)，(乃是參禪學道之喉襟) (this single great matter of life-and-death is the very throat-and-collar of investigating Chan and studying the Way), and states the comparison plainly: (資生貴圖求富)，(參禪貴圖求悟) (as making a living prizes seeking wealth, investigating Chan prizes seeking awakening). Zhongfeng Mingben describes people who say they investigate Chan while doing so only with their mouths: (人心浮淺口說參禪) — shallow-minded people 'investigate Chan' only with their mouths, wanting to understand the recorded exchanges as material for conversation, (初無一念要决了生死大事之心) (without a single thought of resolving the great matter). Later records pair the expression with looking at sayings (看話). Render it as ‘investigate Chan,’ following the literal ‘consult / look into’ sense; note the fixed collocation (參禪學道) ('investigate Chan and study the Way'). The records also define the word by its concrete referent: Shitian Faxun (石田法薰) writes (參方衲子)，(出一藂林)，(入一藂林)，(撥草瞻風)，(不憚寒暑)，(喚作參禪) (wandering monks leaving one grove and entering another, parting the grass to gaze at the wind, undeterred by cold and heat — this is 'called 參禪'), then immediately presses (畢竟禪作麼生參) (but after all, how is Chan investigated?) (X70n1386). Shiwu Qinggong opens an evening address: (現前一眾久在叢林)，(謂之參禪)、(謂之辦道)，(殊不知一念未生已前更無別物)，(纔擬心時錯了也) (this assembly has long been in the groves — it is called investigating Chan, called working at the Way — quite unaware that before one thought arises there is no other thing; the instant the mind deliberates, it has already gone wrong) (X70n1399; raised again in 列祖提綱錄 X64n1260). Baichi (百癡) turns the word on itself at a (小參) (informal address): (無禪可參是名參禪)，(無道可悟是名悟道) (no Chan that can be investigated — that is named investigating Chan; no Way that can be awakened to — that is named awakening to the Way) (J28nB202). Two stock formulas recur: (參禪無秘訣)，(只要生死切) (investigating Chan has no secret formula — only that life and death be urgent; 13 hits in 10 allowlist texts, also written 秪要生死切), and the full iron-man quatrain (參禪須是鐵漢)，(著手心頭便判)，(直趣無上菩提)，(一切是非莫管) (25 hits in 20 texts), which the record credits to the layman Li Duwei (李都尉) — (李都尉云)：「(參禪須是鐵漢)，(著手心頭便判)，(直趍無上菩提)，(一切是非莫管)。」 (J26nB183; J26nB182 narrates his awakening verse, 李忽契悟，亦呈偈云).
Senses.Note: Two independently-attributed masters (Gaofeng Yuanmiao 高峰原妙, his 語錄 recorded sayings; Zhongfeng Mingben 中峰明本, his 廣錄 extensive record) use (參禪) (investigate Chan) for the same activity — one framing its temper and aim, one policing genuine vs. mouth-only inquiry. Dahui Zonggao is the acknowledged systematizer of (看話參禪) (‘investigating Chan by looking at sayings’) and is named in the explanation, but no Dahui occurrence is curated here: the strongest Dahui (參禪) passage (T47n1998A, 0864c) sits in a section expounding Linji's (四照用) (his 'four illuminings-and-functions') and invoking Yunmen, where speaker attribution was not cleanly separable, so it was left out per the verify-attribution rule. Zen-scoped grep counts (tag-stripped, 2026-07-11): (參禪) 2950 hits in 336 of the 462 allowlist texts; (參禪學道) 213/111; (參禪人) 135/71; (參禪者) 83/46; (參禪辦道) 4/4. The mouth-only polemic is itself multi-witness: besides Zhongfeng's (口說參禪)。(但欲明悟機緣以資談柄) ('investigate Chan with the mouth only, merely wanting the encounter-stories as talk-fodder'; B25n0145), the (浮石禪師語錄) (Fushi's recorded sayings) has (人心不古)，(口說參禪)，(但欲讀熟幾則機緣以資談柄) ('hearts are not what they were: they investigate Chan with the mouth, only wanting to read up a few encounter-cases as talk-fodder'; J26nB185), and a (五燈全書) (Complete Book of the Five Lamps) verse has (口說參禪心不了) ('the mouth says investigate Chan while the mind is not settled'; X82n1571). The iron-man quatrain Gaofeng deploys is circulating stock credited within the record to the layman Li Duwei (李都尉), not a Gaofeng coinage (J26nB182, J26nB183).
